title: "Module 4: Assessment and feedback"
order: 4

::: {.callout-tip}
## Learning objectives

By the end of this session, learners will be able to:

- Describe the differences between assessment and feedback 
- Understand Nicholl’s 5 Step Model 
- Describe the differences between summative and formative assessments
- Understand when different types of summative and formative assessments are most useful to trainings 
- Describe how feedback can be gathered and reflected upon for instructor growth 




:::
